why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Hold a SkyTrade Genesis NFT Staking applies to SkyTrade Genesis NFTs, so the wallet you use needs to hold one. The Genesis site points people without an NFT to the skytrade_genesis collection on MagicEden to buy one.
2 Step 2 : Connect your wallet on the Genesis site Open the SkyTrade Genesis site and connect the wallet that holds your NFT.
3 Step 3 : Stake your Genesis NFTs Stake the NFTs from the connected wallet on the Genesis site so they start earning Sky Points.
4 Step 4 : Keep them staked to build Sky Points Points grow the longer an NFT stays staked. Follow SkyTrade on X for any update on the program.
